name: Second Look
summary: A spot-the-difference game on two snapshots of an old city street, with hints, a timer and five scenes
about: Two taped-down photos of the same street of pastel shop houses, with kites, a clock, laundry, a fruit cart, a balloon seller and pigeons, taken a second apart. Click or tap anything that changed in either photo and it gets circled in both; wrong guesses cost time and a hover ring shows the same spot in the other photo. Each scene is drawn fresh with a new time of day, from a bright morning to rain and a lit wedding street at night, and the changes are picked at random so no two rounds match.
how: A demo round plays on load; press Let me look, Play, an arrow key or tap a photo to start.
Click or tap a change in either photo; it gets circled in both and the dot row fills in.
Keyboard: the arrow keys move a lens (hold Shift for big steps) and Enter or Space checks that spot.
Wrong guesses cost four seconds; H or the Hint button circles the area of one change, three per game.
Find them all before the timer ends to earn a time bonus and a new scene with more changes; P pauses and hides the photos, R restarts.
If time runs out the missed changes are shown in red; your best score is saved on this device.
